column1: # Read by lib/tests/test-log-dir.sh (bash ticket_log_dir) and by
# both resolvers answer every row the same way.
# Format: one case per line, exactly 6 fields separated by a single TAB.
# Lines starting with "#" and blank lines are skipped. No field is ever empty.
#   2 repos_root  "set" (REPOS_ROOT = a fresh temp dir) or "unset"
#                 anything else is the literal value
#                 otherwise the text plus a trailing newline, where a literal
#                 two-character "\n" stands for a newline and a leading
#                 "<nonl>" means "no trailing newline" (the marker is dropped)
#   5 expect      resolver output, or "UNRESOLVED" (bash rc 1, Python None)
#   6 legacy      bash ticket_log_dir_or_legacy output with STATE_ROOT_STRICT
# "@ROOT@" in env/anchor/expect/legacy is replaced by the temp REPOS_ROOT path
# (or by a fresh temp dir when repos_root is "unset").
